response.rationale: Option A is ranked first as it encompasses both recurrent postpartum mastitis and lactotroph hyperplasia, which aligns well with the 'Lymphocytic hypophysitis (postpartum) with hyperprolactinemia and galactorrhea-amenorrhea, complicated by right puerperal mastitis due to Streptococcus agalactiae' leaf. Option B, 'Hyperprolactinemia', is a component of the leaf but less comprehensive than A. Option D, 'Bacterial mastitis (Streptococcus agalactiae)', is also a component but again less comprehensive than A. All three matched options (A, B, D) have the same best_rank and support_score, but A is a more complete description of the overall condition described in the leaf. Option C, 'Subclinical breast abscess', is unmatched and therefore ranked last.
